lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Welcome to Sunny School! Ready to join the Eco Crew?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Walk to a glowing school location to start a mission. I'll follow along!

lines.speaker: maple
lines.text: Our school garden needs help. Can you spot where we are wasting resources?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Look near the tap and watering area. What do you notice?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: You noticed the problem! Reporting a leaking tap to a school adult can help conserve water.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Try looking for a solution that saves water and keeps students safe.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Oh crumbs! Our lunchtime waste is piling up. Could your Eco Crew sort it out?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Explore the maze, collect one item, then choose where it belongs at our school. Look for ways to avoid waste first!

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: At Sunny School, fruit scraps go to our compost collection, clean paper and empty cans are recycled, and snack wrappers use general waste.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Great choice! Tell me why that item belongs there.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Not quite. Read the school's collection sign, then try again. Every school can have different rules.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Even better than sorting unwanted packaging? Avoid needing it in the first place when possible!

lines.speaker: sprout
lines.text: Let's become geography detectives. We need observations before choosing an improvement.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Our map has three investigation points. Let's visit them and record what we find.

lines.speaker: sprout
lines.text: This is fictional sample data. Which waste category is largest, and what action might help?

lines.speaker: maple
lines.text: Now try a new school challenge by yourself. Take your time and explain your decisions.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: You can do it! I won't give away the answers, but you can reread each question.

lines.speaker: maple
lines.text: Thank you for helping us think carefully about our school's resources and waste.
